items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...there was a man called H.J. Boasso... And you never knew him, I'm sure. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't think so.

ctx.x: No, it was a drive-in. And they had a, you know, a place inside that didn't seek too many people.

It's funny, you can remember these places and going to them and there was a man called H.J. Boasso who lived back in that neighborhood. Who was in the direct mail advertising business and he played the piano. And you never knew him, I'm sure.
